__doc: Floors per model for the share of verdicts right (applied or not) on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.
floor = min(mean - 2 binomial SE, (n - 2) / n) over the n = 43 verdicts, rounded down (evals/README.md rule 9).

Calibrated 2026-11-07 from 2 local runs per model of the check that decides from what each suggestion asked (one call per file): every model 43/43 in both runs, mean 1.0, so the floor is (43 - 2) / 43 = 0.953, rounded down to 0.95.

The check before it (one call with every patch, judging against improvedCode), 2 runs on the same cases: claude-sonnet-5-5 0.93 and 0.884, gpt-6-sol 0.86 and 0.86, kimi-k2.7-code@openrouter 0.86 and 0.86, deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks 0.837 and 0.837: below every floor.
RATCHET: when a PR moves this on purpose, recalibrate here with two runs as evidence.
